title: Radiation alert
summary: Dosimeter event or ship alert, real or simulated and labeled. A distinction is made between an event confirmed by the ship, a simulated event and an alert reported only by text. Without an event or available dosimetry, exposure cannot be estimated: the missing evidence is stated. Isolated symptoms and the urine module do not provide an exposure estimate. Design decision: an active simulated event uses the same immediate urgency as a real one to exercise the procedure, always labeled as SIMULATED. Informational support only: not a diagnosis or a treatment decision. There are no clinical personnel on board: the steps are first aid and monitoring; treatment depends on mission procedures.

confirmed_event.text: Radiation alert CONFIRMED by the ship: follow the mission radiation procedure.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Follow the radiation procedure; if the decision is made to build the protective shelter, do so.
Wear your personal dosimeter and record its reading.
Isolated symptoms do not indicate exposure or dose: do not use them to decide.

simulated_event.text: SIMULATED radiation event (labeled drill): carry out the radiation procedure as in the drill. This is not a confirmed real exposure.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Follow the radiation procedure as in the drill.

reported_alert.text: Radiation alert REPORTED by text, not confirmed: check the dosimeter and the ship panel and follow the radiation procedure.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Check your dosimeter and the ship's radiation sensors.

no_evidence.text: No dosimeter event or ship alert is available: exposure cannot be estimated. The urine module does not provide that estimate.

steps.text: If you are concerned, check your personal dosimeter.

candidates.label: Possible radiation exposure (must be ruled out)
candidates.minimum_evidence: Confirmed dosimeter event or ship alert.
